clips.title: The story
paras: At Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the Rune of Nesting lies among four sacred relics. It helps Athridas Bearmantle prepare the ritual that safely awakens the Druids of the Talon from the Emerald Dream.

The Rune of Nesting lies in the Chest of Nesting, deep in the winding chambers of Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Night elf druids hibernate in underground barrow dens to commune with nature through the Emerald Dream. To return safely, the Druids of the Talon need a precise awakening ritual guided by sacred relics. The rune is one of four: the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting. Together, the relics help call the sleeping druids back to the waking world.

Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Ban'ethil Barrow Den, putting its sleeping defenders in peril. Without the relics, the druids risk remaining trapped in the Emerald Dream while invaders desecrate their sanctuary. Recovering the Rune of Nesting and its companion artifacts allows Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar to prepare the ritual that can safely awaken them.
